en: Multiview color postcard with a dark border and three photos of a mountainous city. The front bears the title "PIATRA NEAMȚ." Views show a central square with traffic and historic buildings on a hillside, a modern civic building with decorative facades and landscaped boulevards, and a gardened complex with a long, curved building backed by forested hills. The reverse is printed in Romanian with a Romanian stamp and handwritten message addressed to Bucharest.
